dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned rows and image anchors feed K-Means.
Cleaned images, labels and pseudo-labels feed CNN.
Notes, dates and GlobalIDs feed semantic scoring.
Cluster assignments and reliability feed CNN labels.
Semantic score and date branch feed unification.
Spread bound and spatial override feed unification.
Unified scores and known locations feed monitoring.
Monitoring caveats feed memorandum review conditions.
The GlobalID score and data defects feed the memorandum.
